shortDescription: Implements Ansible module for switch configuration backup and restore.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Configures (force) API version (vX.Y) for acces to the remote device.

options.name: config_type
options.description: Type of configuration file. If this option is used, configuration file is saved to the system.

options.name: file_name
options.description: configuration file name

options.name: forced_reboot
options.description: Apply the configuration with reboot if the configuration has reboot required commands

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport. The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the port to use when building the connection to the remote device.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: recover_mode
options.description: To enable or disable recovery mode. Not applicable if is_forced_reboot_enabled is true

options.name: server_ip
options.description: Server ip address in which file is stored. Not applicable for ST_FLASH

options.name: server_name
options.description: Server name in which file is stored. Not applicable for ST_FLASH.

options.name: server_passwd
options.description: SFTP server password

options.name: server_type
options.description: server type from/to which configuration needs to be copied

options.name: sftp_port
options.description: TCP port number. Applicable for ST_SFTP.

options.name: ssh_keyfile
options.description: Specifies the SSH key to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is the path to the key used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_SSH_KEYFILE will be used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: Adding or reading data

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds for communicating with the network device for either connecting or sending commands. If the timeout is exceeded before the operation is completed, the module will error.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: Configures use SSL (HTTPS) for access to the remote device.

options.name: user_name
options.description: SFTP server Username

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Configures validation of certification for access to the remote device.

options.name: wait_for_apply
options.description: Wait if there is already an ongoing configuration change on device.
